observation.hardware_features: IMU quaternion, gyro XYZ, accel XYZ, tilt-compensated vertical accel, encoder velocities, estimated motion, horizontal LiDAR; route/reference and previous raw action.
observation.caveat: No complete actor observation histories saved; causal dependence cannot be measured from these traces. No terrain preview or ground-truth velocity supplied to actor.

exploration.qualification: Gaussian tails at initialization bias or mean final action, not measured event-conditioned rollout frequencies. Sustained slowdown also requires repeated low actions through the ramp.

prior_authority_reward.qualification: Offline E1 trace reconstruction using captured energy/slip and reconstructed previous estimated PI reference; not a new rollout or PPO result

limits: One training seed, five paired fixed-map reset seeds.
Endpoint trace cues omit original 50Hz IMU samples and full actor tensors.
Reward totals are exact saved raw episode totals; only prior authority returns were reconstructed.
No new simulation, policy training or hyperparameter tuning.
